claim_text: A 360-residue region of the predicted NF1 protein shows significant sequence similarity to the catalytic domains of both human and bovine GAP (GTPase activating protein).
source_title: The neurofibromatosis type 1 gene encodes a protein related to GAP
notes: Full text unavailable (not in PMC), extracted from abstract. Strength capped at 3: sequence-similarity evidence, no biochemical GAP assay in this paper.
